sources.title: Reddit Ads API v3 report endpoint
sources.license: Reddit Ads API documentation terms; citation only
sources.notes: 2026-10-07 review verified: The v3 report endpoint supports up to three breakdowns and documents DATE, CAMPAIGN_ID, and AD_ID in the official reporting schema and metric reference. SPEND is returned in microcurrency and must be divided by one million for currency units. KEY_CONVERSION_TOTAL_COUNT is an available conversion count metric. The guide says UTC is the default report timezone, metrics can take up to six hours to stabilize, and historical totals may change as attribution matures. The endpoint documents a 60 requests per 60 seconds rate limit. The source and CLM-0207 retrieval dates may advance to 2026-10-07. Add the official metric reference as a supporting source so the exact field names do not rely on endpoint prose alone.

The documentation describes asynchronous report request, status, and download flow. The source and CLM-0208 retrieval dates may advance to 2026-10-07.
